test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
If × means +, + means -, - means ÷, ÷ means ×, then what will come in place of the question mark (?)?

13 × 6 ÷ 18 + 98 - 7 = ?
solution:
From the given information: × means +, + means -, - means ÷, ÷ means ×
We substitute the values in the given equation and solve it using BODMAS rule:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f64c9f79d77b59f47195df405b394d1389881df31e18c68888ff4c37e1e42e.png] 

13 × 6 ÷ 18 + 98 - 7 = ?

13 + 6 × 18 - 98
